predeclared_plan.decay: da/ds=-kappa*(abs(Vh)-Vr)_+*a; a=a0*exp(-kappa*D), s in command-path volts
predeclared_plan.background: One group-common Gamma_leak, fixed during RESET; effective background transport approximation, no species assigned
predeclared_plan.fitting_objective: Unweighted original raw log10 RESET residuals on observed absI>=1e-12 and V!=0; no residual floor, denominator change, branch rescaling or robust loss
predeclared_plan.constant_a0: max(geomean(fit-fold training SET conductances)-Fsoft(+.05,Gamma_leak)/.05,0); exclude test SET from this constant
predeclared_plan.evaluations: For each model one full-training fit plus14LOO refits, each starts from all3 fixed starts; no full-data initialization for LOO
predeclared_plan.failure_policy: Retain numerical/solver stops; incomplete folds are not dropped from a claimed full LOO metric.

analytic_solution_checks.path_only_outward_peak_formula: min(Vmax,(Vr+sqrt(Vr^2+4/kappa))/2); not the total-current peak with background
analytic_solution_checks.return_path_property: d(a*v)/dv=a*(1+kappa*v*(v-Vr)_+)>0; hence path current decreases along the return scan
analytic_solution_checks.independent_review: field_law_check subagent checked dose units/continuity, path-only peak and LOO design without fitting

scope: This predicts RESET conditional on preceding measured SET read conductance; it does not predict SET, path formation or series behavior.
LOO is internal conditional prediction among original14 training cycles, not the original heldout set or chronological future validation. Other training cycles may be chronologically later.
a0 is not a free per-RESET fitted parameter. Gamma_leak,Vr,kappa are common within each fit and independently refit using13RESET records perLOO fold.
No waiting or seconds inferred; kappa has unitsV^-2. Bare local voltage equals commanded voltage in this submodel.
Field-driven decay continues even at low current whenever |V|>Vr, so it has no positive-current-threshold tail barrier. Below Vr the path freezes.
Original shape, material table and common Ron fixed; numerical table approximation remains. No ODE or new quadrature.
Parameters hitting bounds or solver evaluation limits are reported, not treated as physical identification.
This is not a completed unified1R/1T1R model, continuous full-history fit, or proof of a microscopic species.

comparison.interpretation: Difference measures the value of prior SET conditioning in this restricted RESET law, not a test of full state formation or unified topology transfer.

budget_scope: 120-second alarm covers fitting and scoring only after all input loads and predeclared plan/source hashes; startup/module/file waiting is separately included in main elapsed where applicable.
